text:
/do-beads run 2026-05-12 progress:

Closed this session: .17.2 (session_fetch.rs for jmap-base-client), .17.3 (dispatcher_minimal.rs for jmap-server). Both follow the canonical .17.1 (parse_eml.rs for jmap-mime) template: tight narrative, ~80-140 LOC, README ## Examples section, quality gates green.

Open: .17.4 + .17.5, both now labeled `human` after discovering the design gap they share — neither `jmap-mail-server` nor `jmap-chat-server` has an axum/hyper/SSE/WS integration surface to wrap. See each bead's comment for options A/B/C and recommendation.

Re-labeling this meta-tracker `human` because:
- bd doesn't auto-close parents when children close (3 of 5 done, 2 paused on human-decision).
- Without a label, /do-beads keeps surfacing it as a P2 ready bead even though it's not directly actionable.
- Drop `human` once .17.4 and .17.5 resolve so the parent closes naturally on the next pass.

Note: the inverted `blocks` edges this bead used to carry (parent → children via blocks, which made all children spuriously appear blocked in `bd blocked`) were removed at the start of this session. The parent-child links remain. The 4 children now correctly appear in `bd ready` when not human-labeled.
